question: Which 5 sellers have the highest total revenue (sum of item price)? Show seller_id and revenue.
generated_sql:
SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue
FROM order_items
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 product categories (English names) have the most items sold? Show category and item count.
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    t.product_category_name_english AS category, 
    COUNT(i.order_item_id) AS item_count
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY item_count DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Which customer state has the highest average review score? Show state and score.
generated_sql:
SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(CAST(r.review_score AS DOUBLE)) AS score
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1
